description: Month-end S&P 500 membership flags for this repo's static ticker list. S&P 100 is a subset of S&P 500, so non-members are excluded from the research universe on that date to reduce (not eliminate) survivorship bias.
source_license_note: Upstream Wikipedia-derived historical constituents; verify license before redistribution beyond this research repo.
limitations: Membership is S&P 500, not official S&P 100 point-in-time constituents.
Names that left the index and are absent from today's static TICKERS list are still missing (residual survivorship).
Ticker renames are handled only for the aliases listed in aliases_applied.
